title: Design a RAG-Based Personal Notes System
description: Conceptually design (and optionally build with a tool like Notion AI) a personal knowledge base that uses RAG to make your notes searchable by AI.
steps: Map your current note-taking: where do notes live, what types of content, what do you search for most?
Design the ideal structure: what categories? what metadata? what should be searchable?
Try Claude Projects: upload 10 of your existing notes/docs and ask questions about them
Note what worked well and what was missing
Write a 1-page design doc: how you would structure a personal RAG system for your work
expectedOutput: A design document for your personal AI knowledge base plus a Claude Projects experiment demonstrating RAG in action.
bonusChallenges: Try building it in Notion AI: organize your notes and use Notion AI to ask questions across them
Test: what happens when you ask a question for which there is no matching document?
